note: Based on the species-level description of Trinervitermes biformis in Chhotani (1997), original in English; the soldier is dimorphic, with the major and minor forms combined in one paragraph; all castes present; synonymic citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head dark golden yellow to brown, the region of the frontal gland paler; nasus red to dark brown, reddish brown at the tip; antennae brown, the apical segment slightly paler; dorsal abdomen pale brown to dark smoky brown; sternites and legs paler, straw-coloured. Head covered with microscopic hairs, generally without long setae; nasus covered with microscopic hairs, with 1 or 2 slightly longer setae at the tip; margin of the pronotum with microscopic hairs; abdominal tergites with short setae, the last few segments with a few long setae; sternites with long and short setae. Total body length 4.00–5.30 mm. Head capsule excluding the nasus broadly pyriform to subcircular, abruptly narrowed anteriorly (length including nasus 2.15–2.52 mm, length excluding nasus 1.35–1.62 mm, maximum width 1.23–1.63 mm); in profile considerably incurved behind the nasus, occiput strongly arched. Nasus short, conical, variable in width at the base, in profile slightly upturned anteriorly (length 0.77–0.95 mm); about one-half to two-thirds of the head length excluding the nasus (ratio of nasus length to head length 0.50–0.67). Antennae 12–14-segmented; in the 12-segmented form segment 3 is 2.5 times as long as segment 2 and about equal to segment 4, in the 13-segmented form segment 3 is about 2.5 times segment 2 and 2.0 times segment 4, in the 14-segmented form segment 3 is slightly longer than segment 2. Mandibles vestigial, without a spine. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, the anterior margin weakly excised in the middle. Minor soldier: colour and pilosity as in the major soldier, nasus slightly paler or slightly darker. Total body length about 3.0–4.0 mm. Head capsule elongate pyriform to subrectangular (length including nasus 1.40–1.73 mm, length excluding nasus 0.85–1.10 mm, width 0.55–0.70 mm); in profile weakly to distinctly incurved, sometimes with a pale swelling. Nasus slender, long, cylindrical, relatively longer than in the major soldier (length 0.58–0.73 mm, ratio of nasus length to head length 0.62–0.76); in profile weakly to distinctly upturned anteriorly. Antennae 12–14-segmented; segment 3 from a little more than twice to nearly three times as long as segment 2; segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 3. Mandibles and pronotum as in the major soldier.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule brown to smoky brown, yellowish brown anteriorly, slightly paler laterally, translucent along the Y suture; antennae, postclypeus, legs and abdominal tergites pale yellow to pale yellowish brown. Head and body with numerous microscopic hairs and a few long setae; sternites more hairy. Total body length 3.90–4.80 mm. Head capsule subcircular (to the base of the mandibles 1.25–1.50 mm, width 1.35–1.63 mm); Y suture distinct. Frontal plate oval, whitish. Antennae 15-segmented; segments 2, 3 and 4 subequal. Postclypeus convex, hairy, about half as long as wide (length 0.33 mm, width 0.65–0.68 mm). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped (length 0.25–0.38 mm, width 0.55–0.73 mm); anterior lobe strongly upturned, weakly to strongly excised in the middle; posterior margin convex, without an incision.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule brown with a reddish tinge; antennae and postclypeus brown to dark brown; pronotum and legs brown with a reddish tinge, as the head; sternites pale brown in the middle, brown laterally. Head and body densely hairy. Total body length 17.5–20.0 mm with wings, 9.0–12.5 mm without wings. Head capsule subcircular (to the base of the mandibles 1.20–1.42 mm, width including compound eyes 1.52–1.87 mm); slightly concave in the middle around the frontal plate; coronal suture absent or present. Frontal plate generally Y-shaped, sometimes triangular, translucent. Compound eyes medium-sized, subcircular (maximum diameter 0.50–0.55 mm). Ocelli suboval, translucent (long diameter 0.18–0.23 mm, short diameter 0.15 mm), adjacent to the compound eyes, about one-third to one-half of their short diameter (eye–ocellus distance 0.05–0.075 mm). Antennae 15–16-segmented; segment 3 longer than segment 2; segments 4 and 5 about as long as segment 2. Postclypeus convex, hairy, less than half as long as wide; anterior margin weakly incurved, posterior margin slightly convex. Pronotum trapezoidal (length 0.90–1.12 mm, width 1.50–1.82 mm); anterior margin nearly straight, without a median incision; posterior margin nearly straight to weakly convex, pale to strongly excised in the middle. Wings pale yellow, transparent; membrane with microscopic hairs; microstructure consisting of spinous papillae (8–15 rows on the anterior margin, 1–5 smaller rows on the posterior margin) and non-stellate microtrichia scattered over the surface; radial stripe pale brown, separating from the radius at about one-sixth of the wing length from the proximal end. Fore wing 15.8–18.0 mm long, hind wing 15.0–17.0 mm long.
